identityAndStateBoundaries: The reference cat called Lily is visual relationship evidence, not canonical runtime identity.
The player-selected companion item remains authoritative; never bake a fixed Buddy into a reusable avatar or scene layer.
Owned/equipped headwear, facegear, backgear and handgear remain authoritative and must replace preview-only components at render time.
Avatar key art v3 is independently accepted only at the recorded exact hashes; it remains noncanonical runtime guidance until explicitly adapted by the primary coordinator.
No Buddy bond, ownership, progress, curriculum, economy or player-state mutation is permitted.

componentContract.calibrationRule: Resolve anchor coordinates from the accepted runtime avatar and selected Buddy bounds; do not hardcode coordinates from pending key art.
occlusionRules: Backgear straps may pass in front of torso while the bag/body remains behind the avatar.
Headwear rear structures pass behind hair; front bands, clips and crowns pass above the front hair mask.
Facegear bridges and lenses sit above face pixels but below intentional front hair strands.
Handgear must meet the primary-grip anchor and may not float outside the hand silhouette.
Buddy must retain a visible ground contact and may not overlap the avatar face, primary handgear, or Store item-detail UI.

Home: Place the selected Buddy near the avatar lower-left or lower-right with readable eye-line and a shared grounding zone.
Keep Buddy speech/name presentation outside both silhouettes and outside navigation/Dream Goal panels.
Preserve the reference's close, supportive avatar-Buddy relationship without copying Lily as a fixed identity.
Store: Keep the avatar as the try-on subject; show the selected Buddy only as a secondary companion unless the companion collection is active.
Try-on swaps only the targeted equipment category and preserves every unrelated equipped category.
Do not bake item cards, prices, labels or buttons into avatar/Buddy art.
Quest: Use the Buddy as an encouragement companion, not a replacement for lesson content or feedback.
Keep character layers clear of story text, answer choices, hint/result areas and reward summaries.
Allow a reusable duo vignette only when both avatar and selected Buddy remain runtime-composited components.

verify: no state conveyed only by animation
